name: Eagles

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles band formed in 1971 from Linda Ronstadt’s circle. Early Asylum country-rock harmony; Hotel California (1976) adds Felder/Walsh dual-lead guitar and becomes the main AOR document. Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) ranks among the best-selling US albums.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶乐队，1971 年从 Linda Ronstadt 圈子组建。早期 Asylum country-rock 和声；《Hotel California》（1976）加入 Felder/Walsh 双主音吉他，成为主要 AOR 文献。《Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975)》位列美国最畅销专辑之列。

shortBio.en: Ronstadt pool → Asylum country-rock; Walsh/Felder Hotel California dual-lead; 1980 split, 1994 Hell Freezes Over reunion.
shortBio.zh: Ronstadt 圈子 → Asylum country-rock；Walsh/Felder《Hotel California》双主音；1980 解散，1994《Hell Freezes Over》重聚。

body.en:
In 1971 Linda Ronstadt hired Don Henley, Glenn Frey, Randy Meisner (ex–Poco founder), and Bernie Leadon (Flying Burrito Brothers) as touring/session players. They played one Disneyland date with her, then signed to David Geffen’s new Asylum label. Producer Glyn Johns guided the 1972 debut Eagles in London—country and rock fused with Leadon’s banjo and mandolin; Take It Easy (co-written with Jackson Browne) led three radio singles; the LP peaked at US No.22.

Desperado (1973) held the mood (No.41). On the Border (1974) brought the first US No.1 single, Best of My Love. One of These Nights (1975) was the first US No.1 album—title track, Lyin’ Eyes, and Take It to the Limit all Top 5. Henley told Billboard’s Craig Rosen the band was tense; Leadon poured beer on Frey’s head and quit. Joe Walsh (James Gang) replaced him—Henley said Walsh made them a stronger rock band, though Walsh’s songs leaned on harmony vocals.

Hotel California (1976) sold about 16 million in the US alone; Henley described its lyric frame as the dark side of the American dream, with Felder/Walsh dual-lead guitar. The Long Run (1979) also hit US No.1; the band paused in 1980. Solo, Henley’s Building the Perfect Beast (1984, The Boys of Summer) and The End of the Innocence (1989, with Axl Rose) outsold Frey’s and Walsh’s solo runs. Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) passed 30 million worldwide and became the best-selling US album of the 20th century in several tallies.

Travis Tritt’s Take It Easy video reunited Henley, Frey, Felder, Walsh, and Schmit; Hell Freezes Over (1994)—named for Henley’s line that the band would reunite when hell freezes over—restarted touring. Rock Hall induction followed in 1998. Felder was fired in 2001; Long Road Out of Eden (2007) returned a US No.1 studio album. Frey died in 2016.
body.zh:
1971 年 Linda Ronstadt 请来 Don Henley、Glenn Frey、Randy Meisner（前 Poco 创始人）与 Bernie Leadon（Flying Burrito Brothers）作巡演/录音伴奏。他们只跟她演过一场迪士尼乐园，随即签约 David Geffen 新成立的 Asylum。制作人 Glyn Johns 在伦敦指导 1972 年首专《Eagles》——乡村与摇滚融合，Leadon 班卓琴与曼陀铃突出；《Take It Easy》（与 Jackson Browne 合写）领衔三首电台单曲；专辑美榜第 22。

《Desperado》（1973）延续音色（第 41）。《On the Border》（1974）带来首支美榜冠军单曲《Best of My Love》。《One of These Nights》（1975）是首张美榜冠军专辑——同名曲、《Lyin' Eyes》《Take It to the Limit》皆进前 5。Henley 对《公告牌》Craig Rosen 说内部关系紧张；Leadon 把啤酒倒在 Frey 头上后离队。Joe Walsh（James Gang）顶替——Henley 说 Walsh 让他们成为更强的摇滚乐队，但也注意到 Walsh 的歌偏向合音。

《Hotel California》（1976）仅美国约售 1600 万张；Henley 称歌词框架揭露美国梦阴暗面，吉他为 Felder/Walsh 双主音。《The Long Run》（1979）亦登美榜冠军；1980 年乐队暂停。单飞方面，Henley 的《Building the Perfect Beast》（1984，含《The Boys of Summer》）与《The End of the Innocence》（1989，Axl Rose 助阵）压过 Frey、Walsh 个人销量。《Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975)》全球超 3000 万，多份统计中为 20 世纪美国最畅销专辑。

Travis Tritt 翻唱《Take It Easy》录影带召回 Henley、Frey、Felder、Walsh、Schmit；《Hell Freezes Over》（1994）——取自 Henley「等地狱冻结 Eagles 才会重组」——重启巡演。1998 年入选摇滚名人堂。2001 年 Felder 被解雇；《Long Road Out of Eden》（2007）带回美榜冠军录音室专辑。Frey 于 2016 年去世。

title.zh: 从 country-rock 到双主音 AOR

body.en:
The Eagles began as harmony country-rock from the Ronstadt pool, with Leadon’s banjo/mandolin and Glyn Johns production. Felder and Walsh added dual-lead electric guitar without dropping vocal stacks.

Hotel California is the hinge: mid-tempo narrative, precise studio arrangement, guitar duel as climax.

Book comparison: their role for country-rock is cast like Cream’s for blues-rock a decade earlier.
body.zh:
Eagles 从 Ronstadt 圈子起步，作和声 country-rock，Leadon 班卓/曼陀铃与 Glyn Johns 制作。Felder 与 Walsh 加入双主音电吉他，同时保留人声叠层。

《Hotel California》是转折：中速叙事、精确录音室编排，吉他对答作高潮。

书中对照：他们对乡村摇滚的位置，类似十年前 Cream 之于布鲁斯摇滚。

title.en: Leadon out, Walsh and Felder in
title.zh: Leadon 离队，Walsh 与 Felder 加入

body.en:
Best of My Love and One of These Nights cleared the path to No.1. After Leadon’s beer-pour exit, Walsh brought James Gang hard-rock vocabulary; Felder was already on One of These Nights.

Meisner left after Hotel California; Timothy B. Schmit joined for The Long Run.

Henley: Walsh made them a powerful rock band, with songs that leaned on harmony.
body.zh:
《Best of My Love》与《One of These Nights》扫清登顶道路。Leadon 倒啤酒离队后，Walsh 带入 James Gang 硬摇滚语汇；Felder 已在《One of These Nights》上录音。

Meisner 在《Hotel California》后离队；Timothy B. Schmit 加入《The Long Run》。

Henley：Walsh 让他们成为强大的摇滚乐队，歌曲偏向合音。

title.en: Hotel California, split, Hell Freezes Over

body.en:
Hotel California (1976) became a US multi-platinum landmark. The Long Run (1979) still hit No.1; Frey said he started the band and was tired, then walked away in 1980.

Greatest Hits kept selling through the hiatus. Hell Freezes Over (1994) named Henley’s quip and restarted tours; Rock Hall 1998; Felder fired 2001; Long Road Out of Eden (2007) another US No.1.

Cross-band: Axl Rose on Henley’s The End of the Innocence; Travis Tritt video reunited the five before the official reunion album.
body.zh:
《Hotel California》（1976）成为美国多白金地标。《The Long Run》（1979）仍登冠军；Frey 说自己发起乐队、走累了，1980 年退出。

精选辑在停摆期继续销售。《Hell Freezes Over》（1994）借用 Henley 那句「地狱冻结」重启巡演；1998 名人堂；2001 解雇 Felder；《Long Road Out of Eden》（2007）再登美榜冠军。

跨乐队：Axl Rose 参与 Henley《The End of the Innocence》；Travis Tritt 录影带在正式重聚专辑前召回五人。

body.en:
Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975) passed 30 million worldwide and often tops US all-time album lists. Hotel California alone moved about 16 million domestically.

Influence runs through production polish and dual-lead AOR more than through punk or metal ideology.
body.zh:
《Their Greatest Hits (1971–1975)》全球超 3000 万，常居美国专辑总榜前列。《Hotel California》仅国内约 1600 万。

影响更多落在制作抛光与双主音 AOR，而非朋克或金属意识形态。
